metadata.title: Robert Tonyan signs with Steelers
metadata.description: The Steelers signed TE Robert Tonyan.
metadata.analysis: Tonyan worked out for Pittsburgh earlier in the week. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Robert Tonyan - Headed to Steel City
metadata.description: Pittsburgh signed Tonyan to a one-year contract Thursday, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Coming off the heels of a season in which he suited up for 17 games with Kansas City, Tonyan is now joining his fifth different team in as many years. Pat Freiermuth and Darnell Washington are returning at tight end for the Steelers, but they released veteran Jonnu Smith back in March, so there's room for Tonyan to potentially snag a spot on the 53-man roster for 2026.

metadata.title: Robert Tonyan working out for Steelers
metadata.description: Free agent TE Robert Tonyan is among the tryout players at Steelers minicamp.
metadata.analysis: Tonyan previously played with Aaron Rodgers in Green Bay. He'll compete for a depth role in the Steelers tight end room if he earns an opportunity.

metadata.title: Robert Tonyan - Not much action in 2025
metadata.description: Tonyan finished the 2025 regular season with one reception for one yard in 17 games.
metadata.analysis: Tonyan signed with the Chiefs' active roster in late August after previously signing to their practice squad. The 31-year-old spent the majority of the season as the No.3 tight end behind Travis Kelce and Noah Gray. Tonyan is set to hit free agency, where he'll likely compete for a depth role once again.

metadata.title: Robert Tonyan - Distant third in TE snaps in Week 14
metadata.description: Tonyan went without a target while playing four of the Chiefs' 64 snaps on offense in Sunday's 20-10 loss to the Texans.
metadata.analysis: As has been a recurring trend all season, Tonyan ranked a distant third in snaps among Chiefs tight ends, with Travis Kelce (91 percent snap share) and Noah Gray (45 percent) comfortably outpacing him. Tonyan has suited up for all 13 of the Chiefs' games this season but has been limited to just one catch for one yard on one target across 126 snaps on offense.

metadata.title: Robert Tonyan Signed to Active Roster
metadata.description: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Robert Tonyan has been signed from the practice squad to the active roster on Thursday. Tonyan was cut by the team on Tuesday, but joined the practice squad a day later. Now, the 31-year-old makes the 53-man roster heading into Week 1. He'll serve as depth behind Travis Kelce and Noah Gray to start the season. Tonyan hasn't been fantasy relevant in a few seasons, but did haul in 53 receptions in 2022. He also produced an 11-touchdown season during his time with the Green Bay Packers. Tonyan has shown he's capable of making big plays in the NFL. However, Tonyan won't have fantasy value to begin the season as the projected third string.

metadata.title: Robert Tonyan - Signed to active roster
metadata.description: The Chiefs signed Tonyan from their practice squad to their active roster Thursday, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
metadata.analysis: Tonyan first signed with KC in mid-March, and he was released on cutdown day Tuesday before joining the team's practice squad one day later. The veteran tight end has now been made a part of the active roster, where he's set to serve as depth behind Travis Kelce, Noah Gray and Jared Wiley. Tonyan has plenty of experience to bring to the table, having seven seasons of NFL action on his resume.

metadata.title: Robert Tonyan - Joins practice squad in KC
metadata.description: Tonyan was signed to the Chiefs' practice squad Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Tonyan was released by the team Tuesday, but he ultimately decided to stick around Kansas City as a member of the practice squad. The tight end has played in 90 regular-season contests in his NFL career, so he'll provide the Chiefs with a rather experienced depth option in 2025.

metadata.title: Chiefs Release Robert Tonyan
metadata.description: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Robert Tonyan was released on Tuesday, the team announced. The move leaves Travis Kelce, Noah Gray, and Jared Wiley as the Chiefs' three rostered tight ends. Tonyan has spent seven seasons in the NFL, and he made waves with 52 catches, 586 yards, and 11 touchdowns as a Green Bay Packer in 2020. Outside of that campaign, he has been unexceptional, as his reception count dwindled to 11 in 2023 and zero in 2024. It remains to be seen whether Tonyan will land on another 53-man roster or if he'll have to settle for a practice squad spot.

metadata.title: Robert Tonyan - Released by Kansas City
metadata.description: Tonyan was released by the Chiefs on Tuesday.
metadata.analysis: Tonyan signed with the Chiefs in March and was unable to do enough during the preseason to earn a spot on the 53-man roster. The 31-year-old tight end recorded just three catches for 49 yards in his preseason action. Tonyan will now look to find a role with another team ahead of the 2025 season.
